CIG Mgr Callback Msg

group CIG_MGR_CALLBACK_MSG

Used to identify CIG Manager Callback Message.

Defines

MSG_CIG_MGR_SETUP_DATA_PATH 0x01

Response msg type for cig_mgr_setup_data_path. The structure of callback data is T_CIG_MGR_SETUP_DATA_PATH_RSP. Used for ISOCH_ROLE_INITIATOR and ISOCH_ROLE_ACCEPTOR.

MSG_CIG_MGR_REMOVE_DATA_PATH 0x02

Response msg type for cig_mgr_remove_data_path. The structure of callback data is T_CIG_MGR_REMOVE_DATA_PATH_RSP. Used for ISOCH_ROLE_INITIATOR and ISOCH_ROLE_ACCEPTOR.

MSG_CIG_MGR_READ_ISO_TX_SYNC 0x03

Response msg type for cig_mgr_read_iso_tx_sync. The structure of callback data is T_CIG_MGR_READ_ISO_TX_SYNC_RSP. Used for ISOCH_ROLE_INITIATOR and ISOCH_ROLE_ACCEPTOR.

MSG_CIG_MGR_READ_ISO_LINK_QUALITY 0x04

Response msg type for cig_mgr_read_iso_link_quality. The structure of callback data is T_CIG_MGR_READ_ISO_LINK_QUALITY_RSP. Used for ISOCH_ROLE_INITIATOR and ISOCH_ROLE_ACCEPTOR.

MSG_CIG_MGR_ISO_TEST_END 0x10

Response msg type for cig_mgr_iso_test_end. The structure of callback data is T_CIG_MGR_ISO_TEST_END_RSP. Used for ISOCH_ROLE_INITIATOR and ISOCH_ROLE_ACCEPTOR.

MSG_CIG_MGR_TRANSMIT_TEST 0x11

Response msg type for cig_mgr_transmit_test. The structure of callback data is T_CIG_MGR_TRANSMIT_TEST_RSP. Used for ISOCH_ROLE_INITIATOR and ISOCH_ROLE_ACCEPTOR.

MSG_CIG_MGR_RECEIVE_TEST 0x12

Response msg type for cig_mgr_receive_test. The structure of callback data is T_CIG_MGR_RECEIVE_TEST_RSP. Used for ISOCH_ROLE_INITIATOR and ISOCH_ROLE_ACCEPTOR.

MSG_CIG_MGR_READ_TEST_COUNTERS 0x13

Response msg type for cig_mgr_read_test_counters. The structure of callback data is T_CIG_MGR_READ_TEST_COUNTERS_RSP. Used for ISOCH_ROLE_INITIATOR and ISOCH_ROLE_ACCEPTOR.

MSG_CIG_MGR_CIS_ESTABLISHED_INFO 0x20

Information msg type for LE CIS Established. The structure of callback data is T_CIG_MGR_CIS_ESTABLISHED_INFO. Used for ISOCH_ROLE_INITIATOR and ISOCH_ROLE_ACCEPTOR.

MSG_CIG_MGR_DISCONNECT 0x21

Response msg type for cig_mgr_disconnect. The structure of callback data is T_CIG_MGR_DISCONNECT_RSP. Used for ISOCH_ROLE_INITIATOR and ISOCH_ROLE_ACCEPTOR.

MSG_CIG_MGR_DISCONNECT_INFO 0x22

Information msg type for LE CIS Disconnection. The structure of callback data is T_CIG_MGR_DISCONNECT_INFO. Used for ISOCH_ROLE_INITIATOR and ISOCH_ROLE_ACCEPTOR.

MSG_CIG_MGR_START_SETTING 0x30

Response msg type for cig_mgr_start_setting. The structure of callback data is T_CIG_MGR_START_SETTING_RSP. Used for ISOCH_ROLE_INITIATOR.

MSG_CIG_MGR_CREATE_CIS 0x31

Response msg type for cig_mgr_create_cis_by_cig_id or cig_mgr_create_cis_by_cis_conn_handle. The structure of callback data is T_CIG_MGR_CREATE_CIS_RSP. Used for ISOCH_ROLE_INITIATOR.

MSG_CIG_MGR_REMOVE_CIG 0x32

Response msg type for cig_mgr_remove_cig. The structure of callback data is T_CIG_MGR_REMOVE_CIG_RSP. Used for ISOCH_ROLE_INITIATOR.

MSG_CIG_MGR_START_SETTING_TEST 0x3A

Response msg type for cig_mgr_start_setting_test. The structure of callback data is T_CIG_MGR_START_SETTING_TEST_RSP. Used for ISOCH_ROLE_INITIATOR.

MSG_CIG_MGR_CIS_REQUEST_IND 0x40

Indication msg type for LE CIS Request. The structure of callback data is T_CIG_MGR_CIS_REQUEST_IND. Used for ISOCH_ROLE_ACCEPTOR.

MSG_CIG_MGR_ACCEPT_CIS_INFO 0x41

Information msg type for cig_mgr_acceptor_accept_cis; Notification when return value of MSG_CIG_MGR_CIS_REQUEST_IND is APP_RESULT_ACCEPT. The structure of callback data is T_CIG_MGR_ACCEPT_CIS_INFO. Used for ISOCH_ROLE_ACCEPTOR.

MSG_CIG_MGR_REJECT_CIS_INFO 0x42

Information msg type for cig_mgr_acceptor_reject_cis; Notification when return value of MSG_CIG_MGR_CIS_REQUEST_IND is neither APP_RESULT_ACCEPT nor APP_RESULT_PENDING. The structure of callback data is T_CIG_MGR_REJECT_CIS_INFO. Used for ISOCH_ROLE_ACCEPTOR.
